data.body: S1 4e teeth-check COMPLETE. Round-2 re-dispatch reported 2 attempts (first tried unconditional infer_model, which broke test_cache_model_settings_attached_only_for_anthropic[openai:gpt-4o] because pydantic-ai's infer_provider('openai') eagerly imports the openai package that rebar's [agents] extra deliberately does NOT install; redesigned around a cheap import-free is_resolvable() using known_model_names() Literal introspection). HOLD-OUT INTEGRITY CAVEAT — RECORD HONESTLY: I restored the FULL oracle into the worktree before re-dispatching, so on round 2 the implementer COULD read the 4 previously-held-out tests. My re-dispatch message described the contract only (never the test text), but the files were readable. Round-1 hold-out was clean; round-2 hold-out was compromised. Compensating control per the skill = the mandatory mutation + refactoring-litmus teeth-check, which I ran in full: M1 success-only teardown (finally -> else in runner) => caught by EXACTLY the held-out test_session_closes_the_client_when_the_run_raises ('the seam-built client leaked when the run raised'), 1 failed; M2 error text drops registered-provider names => 2 failed; M3 builder omits self._closeables.append(client) => 3 failed; M4 unknown provider silently delegates instead of raising typed error => 2 failed. All revert to 7/7 green. REFACTORING LITMUS: renamed private _closeables->_open_clients and _build_anthropic->_make_anthropic_provider; 7/7 still pass => not change-detectors. I also rewrote my own test_provider_session_exposes_a_pydantic_ai_compatible_factory, which had reached into private _closeables via getattr(...,[]) — a latent change-detector that would degrade to a vacuous pass under rename; it now observes real client objects via the seam fixture and proves the precondition (client OPEN before session exit). AC VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY: grep startswith("anthropic") in runner.py => none; providers.py imports nothing from runner; providers.py 225 LOC (<300); runner.py 780 LOC (<800); both test import sites moved to rebar.llm.anthropic_model. Pre-flight: make lint PASS (incl. zizmor/actionlint), make typecheck PASS (382 files).
